observations: Photo 0: a cream coloured domestic sewing machine head on its flat base, sitting on a tiled floor.
Photo 0: the front of the arm reads 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' with 'Super Automatic' in script below it.
Photo 0: stitch selector dials and a stitch chart on the right panel, a stitch length window, and an 'UNTEN / OBEN' (feed dog) control below.
Photo 0: a black electric foot pedal with its mains cable lies beside the machine, so this is an electric machine, not a hand crank or treadle.
Photo 0: the machine is very dusty and grimy, with a pink stain on the bed; presser foot, needle plate and spool pins are present.
Photo 0: no carry case, bobbin case, accessories or a clip of it sewing are shown; the back and underside are not visible.

Photo 0 shows an electric foot pedal and power cable, so it is an electric machine, not a hand or treadle machine.

risks.risk: Motor or pedal does not run, or the machine does not form stitches.
risks.proof: A clip of the machine plugged in, run with the pedal, sewing a line of straight and zigzag stitch on cloth.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, for parts or repair

risks.risk: Motor is rated for 220 to 240 volts or needs a transformer; the plug type is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate on the back or underside of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a step down transformer

risks.risk: Bobbin case, bobbin or other key parts missing, or the hook is seized from long storage.
risks.proof: Photo with the bobbin cover open showing the bobbin case in place, and the hand wheel turned in a clip.

risks.risk: Internal gears worn or broken after heavy dirt and storage.
risks.proof: The sewing clip above, plus the hand wheel turning freely by hand.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine sewing straight and zigzag stitch on cloth using the pedal.
Photo of the rating plate on the back or underside.
Photo with the bobbin area opened showing the bobbin case.
Photos of the back and the other side of the machine.
response.reason: Photo 0 reads Ideal Topstar Super Automatic, an electric domestic sewing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working until a sewing clip is shown; the seller's 'manual' is contradicted by the electric foot pedal.
